messages:
rae: Quick sync: staging showed a subtle perf regression when we auto-split mixed-dim embeds. latency p95 for small dims jumped. Can we decide acceptable behavior?
anya: saw that. The splitter currently preserves the original request semantics but reorders chunks which increases scheduling variance. We should consider a dim-normalization path: align smaller dims to a preferred chunk size before routing.
li: +1 for normalization but that changes bytes/units. Needs clear billing model. Also, normalizing may pad vectors (zero-pad) which affects model semantics for some customers.
frank: alternative: prefer contiguous chunking (keep original sequence order) and send chunk metadata so runtime can avoid requeueing. Padding only as last resort.
rae: runtime note: contiguous chunking reduces head-of-line blocking in the scheduler. zero-pad adds negligible compute but could alter similarity scores for embeddings.
anya: for visibility, propose a new preflight endpoint: POST /v1/embeddings/preflight that returns a plan: {chunks: [...], normalized: true|false, estimated_bytes, preferred_chunk}. This lets console show a "Preview split & cost" modal.
console-bot: Feature request logged: CONS-512 "Embed split preview modal (est cost + sample chunking)".
billing-svc: If we return preferred_chunk in preflight, we can show estimated billing units. We recommend charging based on post-normalized bytes with an optional "original-unit" line item for transparency.
li: let's specify headers for runtime telemetry: X-Embed-Preflight: ok|split|reject, X-Embed-Plan-Hash: <sha1>. Plan-hash helps dedupe telemetry.
frank: tiny UX: add an action on console preview "Auto-normalize (best-effort)" with tooltip: "may zero-pad some vectors; we recommend testing".
rae: sketch of preflight response we could return when split is suggested:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{"preflight_result":"SPLIT","estimated_bytes":6245120,"preferred_chunk":512,"chunks":[{"start":0,"len":3,"dims":[384,384,1536],"bytes":3122560}],"warnings":["padding_required: 2 vectors"]}
```
anya: console should call preflight async for big uploads and show a cost delta compared to sending as-is. Also allow user toggle: "Bill me as original request (experimental)" - useful for enterprise customers on fixed committed units.
billing-svc: experimental toggle ok but needs audit log + opt-in flag per-tenant. We'll emit audit.telemetry entries for toggles.
li: security note: preflight needs to run before authentication throttles to avoid abuse. Rate-limit preflight more strictly than embeddings call itself.
frank: telemetry events to add: embed.preflight.requested, embed.preflight.plan.cached, embed.split.normalized_applied, embed.split.contiguous_applied. Include plan_hash and tenant_id.
rae: rollout: enable preflight.beta for internal tenants + 5% external. Flag name: embed.preflight.v1. Monitor p95 latency of embeddings route, split-rate, and preflight hit-rate.
anya: SDK change: add param embed_options:{preferred_chunk:512, normalize:false}. Default: normalize=false until we validate similarity impact.
li: follow-ups assigned: (1) runtime: contiguous chunking + plan-hash (rae); (2) console: preview modal + toggle (frank); (3) billing: post-normalized units + opt-in toggle flow (billing-svc); (4) SDK: embed_options param and error mapping (anya).
console-bot: Task broken out: CONS-512 -> CONS-512A (modal), CONS-512B (billing toggle)
rae: schedule RFC for normalization tradeoffs by EOD Wednesday. If we see >3% p95 regressions in canary, rollback split normalization.
anya: small note: error contract when reject should be specific: {error:"embed_oversize", code:413, details:{max_bytes:8388608, reason:"mixed_dims_no_split"}} so SDKs can show guided remediation.
frank: agreed. let's also surface "suggested_chunk" in that error.
billing-svc: we'll add billing telemetry: embed.billing.estimate.before && embed.billing.estimate.after tied to request_id.
rae: perfect. thanks all, I'll open canary PR and include telemetry schema.
